primary: Official candidate-minus-parent margin, paired by physical map and seat against the original. Report each map, seat W/D/L, pooled wins/all and official mean margin. Draws count as zero wins. Same-map seat aggregates are the two independent descriptive units. No exclusion or optional extension.
exam: Development only. Both maps permanently excluded from all training and formal qualification. The pre-fixed independent 100-map exam is reserved.
exposure: Only the package produced under this training registration and its preregistered eligibility checks may open these tickets. A failed gate leaves every game unplayed. A redesigned candidate requires its own registration. No replay after exposure and no map substitution.
referee: Cold-start two identical isolated 1.5 CPU/512MiB offline cgroups. Native original public entry, default T=1 and 0.58s adaptive natural search and independent RNG throughout. Play to official extinction or step 299; include time forfeits. Store initialization, query+return parse, p95/p99/max, slow and overage per game, memory, 1500s task and actual opponent search depth.
accounting: Retain zero draws and incomplete infra rows distinctly, and any forfeit in W/D/L. Missing official numeric score implies no claim of all-game mean. Report actual candidate physical actions, deposits, tree control and opponent response from recorded turns.
